task_description: Add a region selector dropdown to the LoL Match History Tracker so users can choose their Riot API region (Americas, Europe, Asia, South East Asia) for match history lookups. This resolves the limitation where only Americas server matches were retrievable.

verification.summary: npm run build and npm run lint both pass. No test framework configured in this project so test_quality is skipped. Docker not available. Semantic review issues addressed in follow-up commit.
